name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into the world of motorsport finance was somewhat unexpected. With a degree in economics from the Universidad de Chile, he initially pursued a career in corporate banking. However, a chance encounter with a former racing driver at a networking event sparked a passion for the high-octane world of racing. He offered his financial skills to a small Chilean racing team, managing their finances with precision and turning them into a profitable venture.

His calm demeanor and meticulous attention to detail quickly made him a sought-after commodity. Ricardo thrives under pressure, expertly navigating the complex financial landscape of motorsport. His ability to forecast accurately and manage resources effectively has made him a key asset to Proton by Premotion. Ricardo takes great pride in ensuring the financial stability of the team, freeing them to focus on performance. His colleagues know him for his loyalty, unwavering dedication, and the occasional late-night emails detailing financial projections.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen to jot down financial ideas, even during non-work hours.
Has a specific brand of Chilean coffee he imports and brews every morning, offering it to anyone who visits his office.
Insists on reviewing every invoice personally, no matter how small, to ensure accuracy.
